title: Add, edit and auto-append projects in ~/.dashboard/projects.yaml from the dashboard command
notes:
~/.dashboard/projects.yaml only changes by hand: `dashboard project` has list, find, init (never over an existing file), open, close, focus. A project opened later is never added, and no aka, site, about or deploy gets filled in (the user's file has names and paths only).
- `dashboard project add <path> [--name <n>] [--aka a,b] [--site <url>] [--about "<line>"]`: refuses a path already listed (by real path) or a name/aka already taken, as a value with the reason.
- `dashboard project set <name|aka> [--aka a,b] [--site <url>] [--about "<line>"] [--deploy name=<n>,role=<r>,address=<a>]...` and `--clear <field>`; `project remove <name>`.
- The app appends name and path when a project is opened that the file does not list (name from the folder, made unique), so the file stays current; never rewrites or reorders existing entries.
- Every write keeps the file's comments and hand formatting (yaml's Document API, yaml@2.9.1), goes through one writer next to projects-file.ts, is atomic (replaceFile), and validates against the same schema readProjects uses (unknown keys refused).
- Tests for add/set/remove/append, the refusals and comment preservation. docs/projects and `dashboard project --help` updated.
